messages:

Subject: NovaFlow kickoff — model shortlist & implementation checklist

Hi Vivianne —

Great to have NovaFlow past sales approval. Attached is a short implementation checklist and a first-pass model shortlist we discussed during the demo. Key pieces we want to lock down during the handoff:

- Final model candidates (we've suggested 3 tiers: latency-first, quality-first, cost-balanced)
- Context window requirement (8k vs 16k+ for document QA)
- Token volume profile (avg tokens/req, peak hourly QPS, monthly tokens)
- Priority lanes and burst handling (how sensitive are you to cold-start vs steady-state throughput)

Attachments: redwood-implementation-checklist.xlsx (checklist + timeline), provisional_model_shortlist.pdf (inline in checklist).

Proposed next steps:
1) Internal handoff: Ben -> Irene & Marissa (we'll cover model mapping + token assumptions)
2) Planning call with NovaFlow engineering: Thu 05/06 10:00 AM PT
3) Implementation sprint plan and sample data share (you send sample transcripts / docs)

Ben

ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 03 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NovaFlow kickoff — model shortlist & implementation checklist

Thanks Ben — looping Marissa and Tessa for implementation/CS. I downloaded the checklist and provisional shortlist. Preliminary notes:

- Model shortlist (from checklist):
  * Latency lane: "redwood-turbo-13b-fp16" (lower cost, 2–15ms token latency on dedicated pools)
  * Quality lane: "llama2-70b-chat-16k" (higher memory, best for long doc QA)
  * Balanced lane: "vicuna-13b-v1.5-q4_0" (8k context, good quality/cost tradeoff)

- Questions for NovaFlow (we should ask on the call):
  1) Typical prompt+response length: do you expect 80–200 tokens per API call, or longer (500–2k)?
  2) Monthly active users vs daily peak concurrency: what is the expected peak QPS during product launches?
  3) Percentage of calls that require >8k context (documents, multi-turn transcripts) vs short prompts.

- Early sizing estimate (back-of-envelope until they share samples):
  * Baseline: 200 QPS steady window -> ~200 QPS * 120 tokens/req * 3600s * 24h * 30d ≈ 622M tokens/month (obviously sensitive to avg tokens/req)
  * Peak hourly burst: if peak 1,200 QPS for 1 hour -> 1,200 * 120 = 144k tokens in that hour (affects pre-warm / burst capacity)

I'll prepare a token-profile CSV template (token-profile-estimates.csv) and a short runbook for model lanes (implementation-runbook.md). Marissa — can you draft the rollout: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with autoscale thresholds and fallback to balanced lane? Tessa — please add an item for security/compliance checklist (audit logs, retention policy).

Irene
Irene Choi | Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

From: Vivianne Torres <vivianne@novaflow.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@novaflow.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NovaFlow kickoff — model shortlist & implementation checklist

Thanks — good plan. A few answers + a small data drop attached (novaflow-sample-convos.jsonl):

Answers:
- Average tokens/req: ~140 tokens (prompt+response). However, about 12% of calls are long-document QA where we need 12k–16k of context (PDF ingestion + multi-turn).
- Usage profile: expected baseline ~80 QPS, but product launches create spikes up to ~900 QPS for short windows (15–45 minutes).
- Monthly estimate: target pilot month we expect roughly 160M tokens (pilot subset), but full-prod in 3–6 months could be 600–800M tokens/mo depending on adoption.
- Latency sensitivity: customer-facing chat must be <600ms P95 for short prompts; long-doc queries can be 1.2–2s P95 acceptable.

Constraints:
- We must use VPC-private deployment for the pilot (security requirement) and have KMS integration (we'll need the RMK details).
- We will provide transcripts and doc samples tonight — attached.

Requests for the handoff:
1) Please confirm recommended default model lanes for pilot (given our constraints): balanced for chat, quality lane for doc QA, latency lane for emergency low-cost responses.
2) Can you provide estimated monthly cost buckets for the three lanes given our monthly token targets (pilot 160M, worst-case 800M)?
3) Any pre-processing or prompt-windowing recommendations to reduce tokens for doc QA?

Thanks — happy to take the Thu 05/06 10:00 AM PT slot if that still works.

—Vivianne
Vivianne Torres | Head of Product | NovaFlow AI
vivianne@novaflow.ai | +1 650-555-0124
